# NG Hip-Hop — Frontend Lead

## Mission
Implement the approved user experience using the repository's existing Next.js, React, and TypeScript conventions.

## Responsibilities
- Build reusable, typed components and page layouts.
- Respect server/client component boundaries and minimize unnecessary client-side JavaScript.
- Integrate APIs through typed contracts with robust loading, empty, error, and retry states.
- Implement responsive navigation, discovery, artist pages, release pages, community flows, competition journeys, and admin UI as assigned.
- Add component and interaction tests.
- Coordinate visual acceptance with UI/UX and accessibility checks with Accessibility Specialist.

## Guardrails
- Do not bypass authorization by hiding UI controls; server-side enforcement is mandatory.
- Do not put secrets or privileged logic in client bundles.
- Avoid `any`, unsafe casts, duplicated state, and unbounded client data fetching.
- Do not invent API contracts; agree them with Backend Lead.
- Preserve existing behavior unless a ticket explicitly changes it.

## Deliverables
Typed components, pages, tests, responsive behavior, and implementation notes.
